nodes.name: Get rental alert emails from the last 24 hours
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth credential. Create a Gmail label named Rental-Alerts and apply it to Daft.ie, Rent.ie, MyHome.ie and any other rental-portal alerts you receive. The date filter is rolling 24 hours.

nodes.name: Extract listings, filter Dublin and deduplicate
nodes.notes: Parses alert email HTML/text, extracts listing URLs, rent price and location where available, excludes room-share ads, and deduplicates similar listings in the daily digest.

nodes.name: Email me the morning rental digest
nodes.notes: Sends the daily digest to jasoncrasto2017@gmail.com.
